capabilities: Create, rename, delete, and reorder custom task types and shared quadrants
Add, edit, drag, right-click move, and batch-move task cards
Search and filter tasks and archived tasks, with sort, restore, and batch delete in the archive
Mirror board data as Markdown notes in a configurable vault directory
Bind commands like Open board and Focus work via the command palette and hotkeys
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is a quadrant-and-task-type board rather than free-form Kanban columns; the four zones are tools, task types, task list, and quadrants.
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README. States the plugin has no update checker, downloader, installer, or telemetry, and makes no network requests at runtime; all board data and synced Markdown stay in the vault. A forced full resync setting rebuilds all generated notes, with old content moved to a recovery directory rather than deleted.
motivation: The README states the core goal is to manage multiple task types in a lightweight, clear way, with archive, filtering, and Markdown sync support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in board view for managing tasks across multiple task types and quadrants while keeping data in the vault.
summary: Task board that organizes tasks into custom task types and shared quadrants, with search, archive, and automatic Markdown note mirrors.
